label: Tomato___Bacterial_spot
description: Small water-soaked circular lesions on foliage caused by Xanthomonas species.

label: Tomato___Early_blight
description: Concentric ring target-like brown necrotic spots caused by Alternaria solani.

label: Tomato___Late_blight
description: Rapidly spreading pale to brown lesions with white sporulation caused by Phytophthora infestans.

label: Tomato___Leaf_mold
description: Pale green to yellow spots with olive green velvety mold patches caused by Passalora fulva.

label: Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot
description: Numerous small circular brown spots with dark margins and gray centers caused by Septoria lycopersici.

label: Tomato___Spider_mites
description: Fine yellow speckling, stippling, and webbing caused by Tetranychus urticae infestation.

label: Tomato___Target_spot
description: Zonate necrotic lesions with light-brown centers caused by Corynespora cassiicola.

label: Tomato___Yellow_leaf_curl_virus
description: Upward leaf curling, severe stunting, and interveinal chlorosis transmitted by whiteflies.

label: Tomato___Mosaic_virus
description: Mottled light and dark green patterns with distorted foliage caused by Tobacco/Tomato mosaic virus.

label: Tomato___Healthy
description: Vibrant green leaf foliage without pathological lesions or parasitic infestations.

label: Potato___Early_blight
description: Dark brown necrotic lesions with concentric rings caused by Alternaria solani.

label: Potato___Late_blight
description: Irregular dark water-soaked patches caused by Phytophthora infestans, devastating in cool damp weather.

label: Potato___Healthy
description: Healthy vigorous potato foliage without blight or bacterial infection.

label: Pepper___Bacterial_spot
description: Small yellow-green circular lesions turning dark brown with greasy texture caused by Xanthomonas campestris.

label: Pepper___Healthy
description: Firm, uniform deep green leaves without bacterial spotting or chlorosis.

label: Maize___Gray_leaf_spot
description: Rectangular tan-to-gray necrotic lesions bounded by leaf veins caused by Cercospora zeae-maydis.

label: Maize___Common_rust
description: Golden-brown to cinnamon colored powdery pustules on both leaf surfaces caused by Puccinia sorghi.

label: Maize___Northern_leaf_blight
description: Cigar-shaped elliptical grayish-green or tan lesions caused by Exserohilum turcicum.

label: Maize___Healthy
description: Broad, smooth green blades free from fungal pustules and blights.

label: Apple___Apple_scab
description: Olive-green to velvety dark brown lesions on foliage caused by Venturia inaequalis.

label: Apple___Black_rot
description: Circular frog-eye leaf spots with purple margins caused by Botryosphaeria obtusa.

label: Apple___Cedar_apple_rust
description: Bright yellow-orange or rusty spots with dark central dots caused by Gymnosporangium juniperi-virginianae.

label: Apple___Healthy
description: Lush green foliage without fungal discoloration or rust spotting.

label: Grape___Black_rot
description: Circular reddish-brown spots with dark borders and tiny pycnidia caused by Guignardia bidwellii.

label: Grape___Esca_black_measles
description: Tiger-stripe interveinal necrosis and chlorosis caused by a complex of fungal wood pathogens.

label: Grape___Leaf_blight
description: Irregular reddish-brown lesions with distinct dark borders caused by Pseudocercospora vitis.

label: Grape___Healthy
description: Unblemished green palmate leaves with healthy venation and vigor.

label: Peach___Bacterial_spot
description: Angular purple-brown lesions that drop out leaving a shot-hole appearance, caused by Xanthomonas arboricola.

label: Peach___Healthy
description: Long lanceolate green leaves without shot-holes or bacterial cankers.

label: Strawberry___Leaf_scorch
description: Small purplish spots enlarging into dark brown patches that scorch leaf edges, caused by Diplocarpon earlianum.

label: Strawberry___Healthy
description: Trifoliate dark green serrated leaves free from marginal necrosis or scorch.

label: Cherry___Powdery_mildew
description: White talcum-like powdery fungal growth and leaf curling caused by Podosphaera clandestina.

label: Cherry___Healthy
description: Smooth ovate leaves without fungal mildew or distortion.

label: Rice___Bacterial_leaf_blight
description: Water-soaked to yellowish-white wavy stripes along leaf margins caused by Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae.

label: Rice___Brown_spot
description: Oval to circular dark brown lesions with gray or whitish centers caused by Bipolaris oryzae.

label: Rice___Leaf_blast
description: Spindle or diamond-shaped lesions with gray centers and reddish-brown borders caused by Magnaporthe oryzae.

label: Rice___Healthy
description: Erect, slender emerald-green blades without lesions or marginal chlorosis.
